name: Stacking Plan
note: A stacking plan whose floors are CSS grid tracks sized in fr units of each suite's square footage, so the building is drawn to scale, and every suite is its own size container that sheds detail as it narrows while two-stage color-mix(in oklch) ramps keyed to per-suite custom properties colour it by expiry, rent reversion or industry. Rolling the horizon forward hatches every lease that would lapse and recomputes the KPIs, the subgrid expiry ladder and the suite card from the same rent roll; set --dre-stack-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Rent Roll & Arrears
note: Every figure is settled from one FIFO ledger per household (payments clear the oldest charge first), so the twelve-month payment matrix, balances, age buckets, KPIs and collection-rate line always agree and re-settle live when a payment or fee waiver is recorded in the drawer. The bulk-action bar appears through :has() on the checked rows, sorting reorders with FLIP and the sticky header gains its shadow from a scroll timeline on the table's own scroller; set --dre-arrears-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: NOI Bridge
note: A hand-built GPR-to-NOI waterfall with budget ghosts, where every asset and the fund roll-up share one chart of accounts, so switching asset or period tweens each bar's top and bottom (and the axis) in one staggered rAF pass instead of redrawing. The KPIs, line-item listbox, rail chips and the monthly trend for whichever line you pick are summed from the same twelve months of actuals and budget; set --dre-noi-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Maintenance SLA
note: Work orders run against a simulated clock you can step or play, and each SLA ring is a conic gradient driven by a registered @property number, so rings ease as time moves and land red, with a shake and a toast, the moment a job breaches. Queue, kanban board (FLIP moves through the Web Animations API) and building-by-trade hotspots are three views of the same records, the play loop pauses off screen, and --dre-work-h can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Development Cost Report
note: Earned value done properly: each package's planned, earned and actual curves come from its own baseline, slip and cost performance, so CPI, SPI, the S-curve with its CPI-based forecast and the package table are one calculation that re-runs for any month you scrub to. Approving, rejecting or undoing a change order moves money between contingency and a package and re-forecasts the final cost; set --dre-build-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Tenant Health
note: A quadrant scatter of occupancy cost ratio against sales growth, computed from 24 months of each tenant's sales, so switching the 3, 6 or 12-month window springs every bubble to its new place on a transform transition while the ranking re-sorts with FLIP, and the same scores colour a hand-drawn site plan through color-mix(in oklab) ramps. Each tenant card breaks the health score into five weighted factors over a sales-versus-occupancy-cost sparkline; set --dre-tenant-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Valuation Scenarios
note: A full levered acquisition model (NOI build, interest-only debt, sale at an exit cap, bisection IRR) re-runs for every figure: the KPIs, the equity J-curve, a profit waterfall that sums exactly to profit, a max bid solved back from the target IRR and a 7 × 7 sensitivity grid whose target contour is traced by marching squares. Scenarios, grid cells and the comps-derived exit cap ease every assumption through one tween, so sliders, chart and grid move together; set --dre-value-h to 100dvh in an app.
